name: Scene Auto-Encoder
definition: A method to encode a set of RGB images with camera poses into a 3D neural field represented as density and feature voxel grids, enabling novel view synthesis and serving as input for latent compression.
summary: The Scene Auto-Encoder encodes RGB images into discrete density and feature voxel grids via a 2D CNN and frustum lifting, distinguishing itself from continuous MLP-based NeRFs.
